title: A Clinical Trial on the Efficacy and Safety of TQH3906 in the Treatment of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multi-center Phase II Clinical Trial Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of TQH3906 in the Treatment of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of TQH3906 in treating systemic lupus erythematosus.

arms.d: 16 mg TQH3906 capsule, oral administration, once daily, for a duration of 48 weeks.
24 mg TQH3906 capsule, oral administration, once daily, for a duration of 48 weeks.
Placebo, oral administration, once daily, for a duration of 48 weeks.

primary.m: The percentage of participants who achieved Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Responder Index 4 (SRI-4)
